title: Pebble and Flicker's Moon Puddle
markdown:
Whoooo-hooo! Come closer, little listener, and let me tell you a story from the whispering woods. The moon, a big, soft circle of light, smiled down on the sleepy trees. Gentle, silver shadows played hide-and-seek on the ground. By the Willow Whispers stream, where the water sang a soft, bubbly song, like a little lullaby, played Pebble the puppy and Wisp the woodmouse. Pebble’s little tail went thump-thump-thump on the soft grass. It was a happy sound. Wisp had bright, twinkly eyes and sat so still, happy to watch.

Then, Pebble lifted his floppy ears. "Whoooo is that?" he woofed softly. A tiny lantern fish bobbed in the water. Its little light was dim. "Oh my," whispered Wisp. "That must be Flicker. He looks so sleepy." Flicker the lantern fish gave tiny, watery sighs.

Pebble’s warm heart felt a flutter. He always wanted to help make things happy. "We must help him!" Pebble said in his sweet puppy voice. Pebble loved to chase away any sadness. Wisp nodded his little head. "Yes, dear Pebble," he chirped. "We must help Flicker find his home. The moon puddle is where he belongs." Wisp told Pebble about the moon puddle. It was a small, round place in a smooth stone, filled with water that shimmered like captured moonbeams. It was a cozy bed for sleepy lantern fish.

So, very, very gently, Wisp found a big, soft leaf. It was smooth and green and smelled like sweet rain. Pebble nudged Flicker onto the leaf with his soft nose. Flicker’s little light glowed a little brighter. "To the moon puddle," Wisp whispered. "Where the water sings to sleepy friends."

Pebble and Wisp padded along, carrying the leaf so carefully. The leaves overhead whispered a soft song in the warm air. The breeze smelled sweet, like clover. Pebble loved to wiggle and run! He wanted to pounce and play. As they walked past tall reeds that rustled like little green dancers, Pebble gave a happy little hop. The leaf with Flicker wobbled just a tiny bit. Flicker’s light flickered.

Pebble stopped. He saw Flicker’s light. He remembered Wisp’s slow, gentle way. Pebble sat down. His bouncy energy calmed like a soft cloud. "Oh, Flicker," he whispered low and soft. "I am sorry. I will be calm. You are safe with us. We will go very, very slow." Pebble nudged the leaf again, ever so slow. His tail gave a gentle, soft wag.

Wisp patted Pebble’s paw. "You are doing so well, dear friend," he chirped. "Your kindness shines, Pebble!" They walked on, the path now smooth and quiet. Soon, through the soft moonlight, they saw it! A little round pool in a stone. The water shone like a piece of the sky. It was the moon puddle!

With great care, they put the leaf by the water. As the leaf touched the puddle, Flicker’s light glowed bright, then brighter still! He wiggled with joy and slid into the shimmering water. His light danced like a tiny star. He circled once, then settled with a happy sigh. The water sang a soft, bubbly song. Flicker’s light shone with pure happiness.

Pebble and Wisp watched. Their hearts felt warm and happy. They had helped Flicker find his home. Pebble felt a quiet, deep happy feeling, like the moonlight itself. Wisp smiled, his bright eyes reflecting the moon puddle’s glow. "All is well," he whispered.

The moon was high now, a big silver friend in the dark sky. The world was quiet and peaceful. Pebble yawned a big, sleepy yawn. His floppy ears drooped. Wisp curled up close. They snuggled into the soft grass, listening to the stream and Flicker’s happy light twinkling in the moon puddle. And so, as the sleepy stars blinked open, like tiny diamonds on dark velvet, Pebble and Wisp, safe and warm and full of quiet happiness, drifted off to slumber, their dreams filled with soft moonlight and happy little lights.
characters: Pebble the puppy, Wisp the woodmouse
